validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <parallel id="p">
    <state id="r1" initial="r1a"><state id="r1a"/><state id="r1b"/></state>
    <state id="r2" initial="r2a"><state id="r2a"/><state id="r2b"/></state>
    <transition event="both" target="r1b,r2b"/>
  </parallel>
  <state id="a"><transition event="start" target="p"/></state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition targets are whitespace-separated, not comma-separated: `r1b,r2b` is not one state ID
notes: `target` is a space-separated list of state IDs; a comma makes the list one ID that no state declares
diagnostics.help: separate the target IDs with spaces: `r1b r2b`
